title: Pretérito: Practice
description: Authored B1 practice set for the preterite: regular forms, the common irregulars (fui, hice, tuve, dije…), and spelling changes (llegué, busqué, empecé, leyó).

lessons.summary: The preterite (pretérito) is the simple past for completed, bounded events: actions that happened at a specific time or a definite number of times. Regular endings for -ar: -é, -aste, -ó, -amos, -asteis, -aron; for -er/-ir: -í, -iste, -ió, -imos, -isteis, -ieron. Key irregulars share a special stem with no accents: ser/ir (identical: fui, fuiste, fue, fuimos, fueron), hacer (hice, hizo…), tener (tuve…), estar (estuve…), decir (dije, dijeron…), poder (pude…), poner (puse…), venir (vine…), dar (di, dio…). Spelling changes in 'yo': -car → -qué (buscar→busqué), -gar → -gué (llegar→llegué), -zar → -cé (empezar→empecé); and i→y in the 3rd person of leer/oír (leyó, leyeron).

examples.english: We went to the cinema last night.
It was very hot on Saturday.
I arrived late to the meeting.

examples.spanish: Ella leyó el libro en un día.
examples.english: She read the book in one day.

items.explanation: -ar, yo: -é → hablé.
-ar, él/ella: -ó → habló.
-er, yo: -í → comí.
-er, tú: -iste → comiste.
-ir, ellos: -ieron → vivieron.
-ar nosotros preterite is 'hablamos', identical to the present; context tells them apart.
ir and ser share the same preterite: fui, fuiste, fue, fuimos, fueron.
ser = ir in the preterite: fue.
hacer → hizo (c changes to z to keep the sound).
tener → tuve (irregular stem, no accent).
estar → estuve (irregular stem).
decir → dijeron (j-stem drops the i: dijeron, not dijieron).
poder → pude (irregular stem).
venir → vine (irregular stem).
dar takes -er/-ir endings with no accents: di, diste, dio, dimos, dieron.
-gar → -gué in 'yo' to keep the hard g: llegué.
-car → -qué in 'yo' to keep the k sound: busqué.
-zar → -cé in 'yo': empecé (Spanish avoids 'ze').
leer → leyó: the i between vowels becomes y.

items.promptEnglish: Yesterday I spoke with my boss.
items.explanation: A completed event at a specific time ('ayer') takes the preterite: hablé.

items.promptEnglish: Last night we went to the cinema.
items.explanation: ir preterite, nosotros: fuimos.

items.promptEnglish: On Saturday it was very hot.
items.explanation: A bounded past event: hacer → hizo.

items.promptEnglish: Yesterday I arrived late to the office.
items.explanation: A single completed event at a specific time takes the preterite: llegué.

items.prompt: Escribe una frase en pretérito sobre algo que hiciste ayer.
items.promptEnglish: Write a preterite sentence about something you did yesterday.
items.guidance: Must be grammatical Spanish using the preterite for a completed past action (e.g. 'Ayer terminé el proyecto'). Mark incorrect if it uses the imperfect (e.g. 'terminaba') or the present.
items.sampleAnswer: Ayer fui al mercado y compré fruta.
items.explanation: A completed action at a specific time takes the preterite.
